task: T1: write scripts/exec-container.sh, the third executor binding, in the same shape as scripts/exec-qwen.sh — a comment block stating the contract, then ONE `exec`. It takes the prompt as `$1` and reads ROOT from the environment (`R="${ROOT:-$PWD}"`), exactly as exec-qwen.sh and exec-codex.sh do, and it must contain no retry, no gate invocation, no evidence writing and no stopping logic: specs/executor-binding sections 3 and 7 make a binding thin by contract, and a decision added here has to be reimplemented by every future binding. Build exactly the command in spec.md section 3.1: `--rm`, `-v "$R:$R"`, `-w "$R"`, `-e ROOT="$R"`, `--user "$(id -u):$(id -g)"`, `--network "${LOOP_NETWORK:-ai-internal}"`, the image `${LOOP_IMAGE:-ghcr.io/mtgibbs/loop-executor:latest}`, and the prompt as the FINAL argument. Quote the prompt as `"$1"` so a prompt beginning with `-n` or containing a backslash reaches the container byte-for-byte — the same trap log_prompt was written for. Do not hardcode `docker`: read the runtime from `${LOOP_RUNTIME:-docker}` so podman works unchanged. Create no other file.
